messages.subject: TerraClimate
parts:
Hi everyone,

I've just made a new function, 'micro_terra', which connects to the TerraClimate data set of monthly climate at ~4km res across the globe from 1958 to present (well, 2020).

There are also climate change scenarios of +2 and +4 deg C. You can use them by setting the input parameter 'scenario' to 2 or 4.

It connects to the TerraClimate data via opendap and is pretty quick to download, but slower for the climate change scenarios (which are imposed on the years 1985 to 2015).

You can set 'elevatr = 1' to download a finer res DEM than the 4km one and then adjust for lapse rate, as well as slope/aspect/horizon angle if 'terrain = 1'. Also, you can use the microclima solar radiation algorithm to adjust hourly solar if 'microclima = 1'.

If you want to simulate snow or soil moisture properly, you should set 'timeinterval = 365', which will interpolate the monthly data to daily.

Let me know if you find any issues with it.

All the best,
Mike
